## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link an issue if relevant.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. For visual changes, include a representative sample or screenshots and explain what you inspected.

- [ ] Relevant automated checks pass, or failures are explained.
- [ ] Documentation reflects changes to commands, installation, or behavior.
- [ ] New media and dependencies have appropriate provenance and licensing.
- [ ] Private inputs, credentials, and generated work files are excluded.
